name: web-saved-payment-method-card-with-mastercard-mark-and-black-check
title: White payment-method card with a Mastercard tile, 'Mastercard ending in 8888', 'Expires 09/25' and a black check in the corner
whatItIs: A wide white rounded card with a soft shadow and a faint outer glow, a small rounded tile holding red and orange overlapping circles, a bold line 'Mastercard ending in 8888', a grey 'Expires 09/25' and a black check circle at the top right showing it is selected.
whatItMeans: Reassuring and simple; a single black check makes the chosen method clear.
techniques: Show a brand mark in a rounded tile.
Use bold title and grey sub line.
Mark selection with a black check.

vocabulary.definition: A card showing a saved payment method.
A check showing the chosen item.
A small square holding a logo.
A grey line stating expiration date.
